static_traits.name: 马琪
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to confide in, but has not yet expressed feelings of dejection to anyone; has distanced from friends who are in successful bands
static_traits.medical_history: No prior history of similar psychological problems; no prior psychotherapy experience; no obvious history of physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent thinking, able to cooperate with recording and discussion; much self-criticism, low and discouraged mood; speech rate not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Because I failed to join a band, I believe I will never achieve 'big success,' leading to discouragement and low self-worth, affecting my work motivation and overall happiness.
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to break free through counseling from the cycle of self-negation and frustration, and to improve work motivation and overall well-being.
growth_experiences: A few years ago, because the client could not realize the dream of joining a band, the client tried participating in local music groups and was rejected multiple times; initially the stress between work and musical interests was moderate, but with continued comparison with peers in successful bands, the client's damaged self-esteem and reduced sense of self-worth gradually worsened, forming a cognitive frame of 'not in a band = will not succeed'.

special_situations.event: When playing guitar alone, thinking that one is not in a band
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not joined a band, it cannot count as success; there is only one standard of success, which is being recognized in a band
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces practice or wants to give up music to avoid frustration
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough; I will never succeed

special_situations.event: Seeing or thinking about the successful band a friend is in and its achievements
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not reach their achievements, I am a failure and not worthy of recognition
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distancing from these friends, reducing socializing to avoid comparison and being evaluated

special_situations.event: Recalling experiences of being rejected many times by local music groups
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Past rejection shows I have no talent, and I will not succeed in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing the frequency and scope of attempts, avoiding applying again to avoid another blow
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not want me; it means I will not succeed in the future either

special_situations.event: Before falling asleep at night, repeatedly thinking about one's ' lack of success' in music
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only joining a band counts as success; otherwise I am worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly ruminating on past experiences and shortcomings, trying to gain certainty through thinking

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen and recognized through music, join a band and achieve success
core_conflict.fear: Fears being rejected again and feeling shame and failure after being compared, ultimately being negated as 'incompetent / unworthy'
defense_goal: Reduces exposure to comparison and rejection through detachment and avoidance
降低尝试以避免再度受挫
Preemptively negating with self-criticism, reducing the blow from external negation

object_relations.object_representation: Others (especially successful band friends) are judges and rejecters

manifestations: Distancing from a friend who is in a successful band
Although having friends to talk to, not confiding one's frustration to anyone
When not in a band, experiences low self-worth and frustration
outcomes: Reduced enjoyment of music, even avoiding practice

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: Treats 'success = must be in a band' as the only standard
用外界成就衡量自身价值

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, involving excessive self-restriction and reproach, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Repeated self-criticism ('I am not good enough' 'I will not succeed')
Nervous and worried about not doing well when facing practice suggestions, but still tries

contact_model.definition: The individual redirects energy originally meant to be sent outward back toward the self, restraining impulses toward others or the environment and engaging in self-reproach or self-injury.
manifestations: Withdrawing emotions about comparison and rejection and turning them into self-blame and withdrawal
'Punishing' oneself by reducing practice or giving up interests

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: In comparison situations, tends to assume others will judge them by achievement standards (stemming from 'mind-reading' conclusions)
To avoid being 'judged', proactively distancing from successful friends

positive_force: Willing to proactively seek counseling and cooperate in recording automatic thoughts
Still continuously playing guitar and willing to try 'practice without comparison'
Having proactively tried many times to join local music groups, having willingness to act
Has an available friend support network (though not yet used)
negative_force: Catastrophizing and all-or-nothing thinking (narrowing success to 'being in a band')
Excessive comparison and self-deprecation; low self-esteem maintains the problem cycle
Overgeneralization and fortune telling, magnifying the decisive significance of rejection
Social avoidance leads to lack of support and feedback, loneliness and rumination worsen
Rumination and disturbed sleep further weaken daytime work motivation and emotion regulation

target_behavior.behavior: When playing guitar or listening to band-related music, strong self-negation and a tendency to give up appear, reducing / avoiding practice
antecedent: Recalling being rejected many times by local music groups
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized standards narrowly equate 'success' with 'joining a band'; multiple rejection experiences reinforced the belief 'I am not good enough / will not succeed' and catastrophizing cognitions
target_behavior.function: Escaping failure and shame, reducing anxiety and frustration in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Enjoyment of music and sense of competence decline, maintaining low self-esteem and negative emotions, which in turn affect work motivation and performance

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance (distancing from friends who are in successful bands)
antecedent: Seeing or thinking about a friend's success in a band
Interactions or gathering invitations with this kind of friends
target_behavior.core_reason: Social comparison and 'mind-reading' conclusions maintain the belief 'I am inferior to them / will be judged'
target_behavior.function: Escapes the anxiety and shame of being compared and negated
target_behavior.consequence: Social support decreases, loneliness rises, and the cycle of jealousy and self-negation intensifies

antecedent: 设想not yet来依旧without法成功
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralization and fortune-telling maintain the negative schema, attempting to gain certainty and a sense of control through repetitive thinking
target_behavior.function: Temporarily relieves the anxiety brought by uncertainty (a surface sense of control)
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep quality declines, energy and work efficiency drop the next day, further weakening emotion regulation and motivation
